text:
Maya: Quick async check — where are we on the microbatch kernel perf sprint? TL;DR: are we hitting the ~20% token/sec target on p99 for long sequences? Also need owner alignment on KV warmup tuning + prefetch rollout window.
Sam: microbatch PR merged yesterday, running e2e canary on raptor pool. CI shows ~12–15% improvement so far, not 20%. Investigating headroom: kernel loop unroll + memcopy hotspots.
Alex: KV warmup patch is in a draft: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pulls/442 — needs infra sign-off for perf tests. cc @Maya
Maya: cool. Owners for the sprint: Sam -> kernel perf, Alex -> KV warmup infra, Lia -> canary gating & rollback criteria.
Lia: picking up canary gating. Plan: 6h ramp, monitor p99, tail latency, and error-rate. Abort criteria: p99 regresses >5% or errors +0.3%. I'll post dashboard link when the job is live. :white_check_mark:
Sam: two blockers I want to flag: 1) canary traffic has skewed sequence-length distribution (too many short seqs) — need a synthetic replay job; 2) small CUDA alignment issue causing ~2% variance across runs, might need a quick kernel patch.
Alex: replay job queued (priority medium). ETA ~3h. Also added a tiny memcopy coalesce in the draft that may shave a percent. Will push tests after replay completes.
BuildBot: canary job 8421 queued by Alex — status: running.
Lia: also need a quick review on the rollback helper PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pulls/449 — @Sam can you take a look? It's infra but hooks into kernel labels.
Sam: will review within the hour.
Maya: milestone check — goal: cut candidate by Fri EOD. If we miss the 20% target, still aim to ship stable improvements and schedule a focused follow-up sprint. Please update the milestone board and tag PRs with the sprint label.
Alex: Roger. I'll update the board and label the perf PRs; kicking off full long-seq replay under perf-tests.
Sam: opened issue #1187 — observed transient memory spike on 64k sequences during stress runs. Linking ticket to the sprint.
Lia: canary dashboard: https://dash.internal/r/redwood/c/ksprint104 — monitoring now, will ping on anomalies.
Maya: thanks team. If anyone wants pairing for kernel optimization I'll block 2h tomorrow afternoon. Ping here and I'll drop a calendar invite.
